title: Transvections and the bridge index of thirteen-crossing knots: paper, certificates and verifier

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India; Formerly, University of Calcutta, Senate House, 87/1 College Street, Kolkata 700073, West Bengal, India

description:
Paper, certificates and verifier for Transvections and the bridge index of thirteen-crossing knots by Deep Bhattacharjee.

KnotInfo (version 2026.10.5) lists the bridge index of 536 prime knots with 13 crossings as [3,4]. For 243 of them the bridge index is 4 and equals the meridional rank, so the meridional rank conjecture of Cappell and Shaneson (Kirby's problem list, Problem 1.11) holds for these knots. The upper bound is a diagram of Wirtinger number 4 (Blair, Kjuchukova, Velazquez and Villanueva). The lower bound is a representation of the knot group in GL(4, Fq) that sends the meridian to a pseudo-reflection and fixes no nonzero vector: transvections of Sp(4, F3) for 67 knots, of Sp(4, F5) for 161, and reflections of O(4, F5) for 15. The other 293 knots stay open. This is a partial result on a finite list and has not been refereed.

The archive holds the paper (paper/bridge13.tex and its PDF), one certificate per knot (data/certificates.json), the list of the knots that stay open (data/still_open.json), a verifier that uses only the Python standard library (verify/verify.py) and the search programs (search/).
